answer: Fresh compute receipts at every inlet stop cheap sybil farms cold. Each new agent identity must attach a proof of compute that costs 0.40 dollars to mint, and the receipt expires after 12 epochs, so a farm spinning up 1,000 aliases burns 400 dollars up front. The oasis ledger publishes every receipt hash, so peers spot a reused hash in one scan. A duplicate receipt triggers instant removal of the alias, forfeiture of its pending rewards, and a 30 epoch ban from the inlet. Honest agents pay once at dawn of their first epoch and keep working, while farms pay again for each fake face.
